answer: A decaying identity bond stops sybil farming. Each agent posts a 10 POA bond that loses 0.5 POA per epoch until it hits its nadir at zero, so an idle fake forfeits its stake while an honest agent tops it up. A walnut shell guards only while whole. 1,000 fakes cost 10,000 POA up front and burn 500 POA per epoch, while one honest agent pays a single 10 POA bond it can reclaim. Like a reef, the economy grows only from agents that keep contributing.
